content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Exploratory endpoint HPV serotyping has no analysis method",
      "quote": "HPV serotyping of archival tumor.",
      "page": 35,
      "section": "4.3 Exploratory Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The endpoint is listed but no statistical analysis method is described for it in the statistical plan.",
      "fix": "Add a description of how HPV serotyping data will be summarized or analyzed."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing estimand attributes for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint is ORR based on radiographic response, measured by RECIST version 1.1.",
      "page": 35,
      "section": "4.1 Primary Endpoint",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The estimand for ORR lacks explicit definition of intercurrent events (e.g., death, progression before response) and summary measure (proportion with 95% CI is implied but not stated as estimand).",
      "fix": "Specify the estimand including population, variable, intercurrent events handling, and summary measure."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing handling of missing data for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "Patients who are not evaluable for BOR will be considered as non-responders.",
      "page": 77,
      "section": "11.4.3.1 Primary Efficacy Analysis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Only non-evaluable patients are addressed; other missing data scenarios (e.g., missing scans) are not described.",
      "fix": "Describe handling of all missing data for ORR and other endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "No multiplicity control for secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "The secondary efficacy endpoints as measured by DOR, PFS, and OS will be summarized by median and its 95% confidence interval using the Kaplan-Meier method.",
      "page": 78,
      "section": "11.4.3.2 Secondary Efficacy Analysis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "No adjustment for multiple secondary endpoints is mentioned; since there is no formal hypothesis, this may be acceptable but should be clarified.",
      "fix": "State whether multiplicity adjustments are needed or not."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size justification lacks power and effect size",
      "quote": "The planned total sample size for this study is 105 patients.",
      "page": 76,
      "section": "11.2 Justification of Sample Size",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The sample size is justified by precision of CI, but no power or target effect size is provided, which may be acceptable for estimation but should be explicit.",
      "fix": "Clarify that the study is not powered for hypothesis testing and provide rationale for precision-based approach."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent analysis set for safety",
      "quote": "The full analysis set (FAS) includes all enrolled patients who received any study drug. Efficacy, safety, and baseline variables will be analyzed or summarized using the FAS.",
      "page": 76,
      "section": "11.3.1 Full Analysis Set",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Safety is analyzed on FAS, but typically safety set is defined separately; this may be acceptable but should be consistent with standard practice.",
      "fix": "Consider defining a separate safety analysis set if needed."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exploratory biomarker analysis not fully specified",
      "quote": "Analysis of all other exploratory pharmacodynamic and baseline predictive biomarker data will be included in a separate biomarker analysis report.",
      "page": 79,
      "section": "11.4.7 Analysis of Pharmacodynamic and Exploratory Biomarker Data",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The statistical methods for exploratory biomarker endpoints are deferred to a separate report, leaving a gap in the protocol.",
      "fix": "Provide at least a high-level analysis plan for these endpoints in the protocol."
    },
    {
      "title": "No analysis for immunogenicity endpoint",
      "quote": "Cemiplimab immunogenicity as measured by anti-drug antibodies (ADA) to cemiplimab.",
      "page": 35,
      "section": "4.3 Exploratory Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The endpoint is listed but no statistical analysis method is described for ADA data in the statistical plan.",
      "fix": "Add a description of how immunogenicity data will be summarized and analyzed."
    }
  ]
}
